shortDescription: Create and manage Product Versions in the Errata Tool

options.name: allow_buildroot_push
options.description: If True, "Push to Buildroots" may be triggered on builds using this product version. Only makes sense with certain Brew configurations.

options.name: allow_rhn_debuginfo
options.description: "true" if -debuginfo rpms from this product version can be shipped to RHN

options.name: allow_unreleased_rpms
options.description: Determines if the product version is allowed to push containers with unreleased rpms.

options.name: brew_tags
options.description: An optional list of Brew tags. Developers must ensure that their builds are tagged with this Brew tag in order to attach to an advisory. You must specify the default_brew_tag as one of the elements in this list (see CLOUDWF-2) What are the consequences of a completely empty brew_tag list? This might be answered in CLOUDWF-2.

options.name: container_sig_key_name
options.description: Signing key used for container images You almost certainly never want to change this value.

options.name: default_brew_tag
options.description: The default brew tag to use when validating that a build can be added to an advisory example: ceph-4.0-rhel-8-candidate You must specify this tag as one of the elements in the brew_tags list (see CLOUDWF-2)

options.name: description
options.description: example: Red Hat Ceph Storage 4.0

options.name: enabled
options.description: Is this Product Version enabled (developers can file new advisories?)

options.name: ima_sig_key_name
options.description: Signing key for IMA (Integrity Measurement Architecture) example: redhatimarelease

options.name: is_oval_product
options.description: true if this product version supports OVAL generation

options.name: is_rhel_addon
options.description: true if this is some form of RHEL Extras, Addon, Optional, etc

options.name: is_server_only
options.description: true if this product version only supports RHEL server

options.name: name
options.description: example: RHCEPH-4.0-RHEL-8

options.name: product
options.description: Product for this Product Version example: RHCEPH

options.name: push_targets
options.description: One or more push targets (specify a list) See /developer-guide/push-push-targets-options-and-tasks.html for more explanation about these push targets. This list must be a subset of the push targets that are set at the parent product level.

options.name: rhel_release_name
options.description: example: RHEL-8

options.name: sig_key_name
options.description: Release key (eg. robosignatory uses this value) You almost certainly never want to change this value.

options.name: suppress_push_request_jira
options.description: Set to true to suppress creating push request jira tickets. Set to false to allow push request jira tickets. If this value is different from the product's setting it will override it.

options.name: use_quay_for_containers
options.description: The Errata Tool no longer uses this parameter. It is a no-op. Remove it from your playbooks.

options.name: use_quay_for_containers_stage
options.description: The Errata Tool no longer uses this parameter. It is a no-op. Remove it from your playbooks.
